What is the missing number?

$\qquad$ ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14146952/assets/81b70e75c29649960c40e1fde55949f210718ebc3ea188686742605717512933.svg) of $20 = 35$
question.worked_solution:
We can write the given problem as the following product:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14146952/assets/44ceb7ccb604fc5f57bb5be3f77c564716f4bd9281c07d349d89fe298ae0e43a.svg)

Using the relationship between multiplication and division, we can write our problem as follows:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14146952/assets/5c86d175be61156120db260d435e715db5b7e123a707d860a043582469ac0455.svg)

To write this fraction as a percentage, we write an equivalent fraction with $100$ as the denominator:

$$
\dfrac{35}{20} = \dfrac{35 \times 5}{20 \times 5} = \dfrac{175}{100}
$$

Now we can write this fraction as a percentage:

$$
\dfrac{175}{100} = 175 \%
$$
